title: different size action bar and no "menu" button in the "settings" submenu...
body:
As a perfectionist, I tried to find how to change the action bar in the "Settings" and "Find notes" submenus. In addition, there is no "Menu" button in the "Settings" submenu. Maybe someone knows the Java programming language better, tell me how to change it. As I understand it, these submenus use a custom action bar. Tell me how to install a standard action bar?
![rte](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38015067/117815141-d5053600-b26d-11eb-9d5c-c063f85a3cad.jpg)

comments.body:
Thanks for your post.

We are asking people not to use this platform (issues) in order to ask questions when they first open the issue submission page.
Your question is a legitimate question.  So are many other questions that others may have.
If we answer one, we have to answer all.  

We have a limited number of developers and we need to fix serious problems.  We like these issues to highlight to the developers what needs fixing.

For asking questions, please use the current support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
I suspect, this issue does not even has to do with xDrip and its usage itself. It looks like it is an app programming related question.

I didn't think it was either a bug or a feature request.
I agree that it is neither an xDrip usage question.
  
There have been other questions that fall in the same category.  How can I compile; where can I find the description of this class; how can I compile an open pull request; ...

I have no problem doing what I can to answer these questions.  I just don't think this is the right place for them.  Please let me know if you disagree.
